install_steps: Or Debian/Ubuntu: curl -1sLf 'https://dl.redpanda.com/nzc4ZYQK3WRGd9sy/redpanda/cfg/setup/bash.deb.sh' | sudo -E bash && sudo apt install redpanda
note: rpk speaks the Kafka protocol — it works against Redpanda, Apache Kafka, and Redpanda Cloud. Point it at brokers with `-X brokers=host:9092` or save connection + auth in a profile (`rpk profile create`). `rpk redpanda start --dev-mode` spins a local broker in seconds.
